verdict.rationale: A state corporate registry with online filing, tax-payment and entity-search portals could plausibly offer a public API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404, formation runs through PDF upload, fax or mail, and the franchise-tax portal sits behind an image CAPTCHA, an anti-automation gate. Nothing indicates that UI actions can be done programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
